About Lin Lib

Wine and spirits education and exploration

Lin Lib is my library to help you learn, understand, and appreciate wine and spirits. It’s a place for essays, guides, notes — and occasionally, in-person wine tastings where we slow down, taste together, and talk through what’s in the glass.

My Mission

Wine and spirits can feel intimidating or overly complex. My goal is to make this world more approachable, and help you discover more drinks to love along the way.

Credentials

  • Wine & Spirit Education Trust (WSET) Level 3 with Distinction
  • WSET Level 2 with Distinction
  • Certified Specialist of Wine (CSW)
  • Court of Master Sommeliers (CMS) Level 1
  • Cava Academy Cava Educator Advanced and Cava Expert
  • Comité Champagne Champagne Specialist with Distinction
  • Valpolicella Education Program Level 1
  • Sherry Academy Advanced course
  • Rioja Wine Academy Diploma course
  • BarSmarts Professional course
  • Calvados Academy Calvados Ambassador course
  • Pisco Certificate course
